Edge init/doctor/health/readiness pass with spool records, bytes, corrupt, expired, gap, admission, duplicate and rejection metrics all zero.

Hub health/readiness/status/doctor pass with exactly the one sealed synthetic vehicle, zero raw/current observations, pending publications zero, ACK frontier null and latest observation ID zero.

A supported read-only ledger observer records zero Edge lineages, sequence dispositions, applications and pending publications before submission; inability to open the ledger is not a zero assertion and closes the gate.
The shared build lock is absent and actor contract/authorization/guard/result/temp/output paths remain absent.
empty_baseline_gate.receipt: Publish one owner-only ready descriptor and one redacted Hub review receipt. Both Edge and Hub must independently accept exact hashes, identities, PIDs, listeners and zero-state values before the coordinator can consider a submit-once decision.

submit_once_event_gate.authorized_event: Exactly one synthetic VehicleName-only V datum through the accepted helper and r5 guard; no retry, replay, duplicate or second timestamp.
sealing_order_after_authorization: Assign the fresh transaction ID and canonical VehicleName payload inside the already admitted cohort.
Write binding.json at mode 0600 with event_authorized=false, the exact sealed identity, endpoint, transaction ID and canonical payload; compute its SHA-256 without publishing the identity value.
Write authorization.json at mode 0600 with event_authorized=true, invocation_count=1, retry_or_replay=false, exact binding/helper/payload/TLS hashes, bounded timeout and short expiry.
Write contract.json at mode 0600 embedding the byte-exact authorization object and exact path/hash/mode references for binding, helper, TLS inputs and outputs.
Independently rehash and compare contract, authorization, binding, helper and TLS public inputs; verify all actor outputs including the derived temporary path are absent and disjoint.

Invoke the exact r5 guard once with the ten reserved absolute path arguments. The guard reads one clock, exclusively creates guard/output, spawns the helper once and atomically publishes exactly one result.

required_success_evidence: Actor result is completed with exit code 0, the one guard record and one final result bind the exact transaction, payload, helper and certificate hashes, and no result temporary file remains.
Helper output contains the accepted identity marker and one matching binary receiver ACK for the exact topic, transaction ID and message ID; it contains no private key or bearer value.
Receiver reports exactly one newly admitted message for the sealed vehicle identity and no duplicate or rejection increment.
Edge records exactly one new admission and one durable encrypted spool sequence for the event, with no corruption, expiry, gap, retry or duplicate.

Hub's supported read-only ledger observer records one matching lineage/sequence disposition/application and the exact assigned identifiers, while the public projection exposes exactly one VehicleName value for the sealed vehicle.
The Hub durable commit record must precede the Edge ACK/frontier advancement in the ordered evidence; timestamp-only inference is insufficient when durable sequence identifiers can be compared.
Edge advances the ACK frontier through the exact event sequence only after Hub commit, removes the acknowledged spool record and reaches pending/spool zero.
A following authenticated Hub pull returns records=[] and gaps=[]; a second producer invocation is absent and all admission/application counts remain stable for a final five-second observation.
post_event_observation.acceptance_rule: Every exact event, durability, frontier, projection and cleanup assertion must pass. A receiver ACK alone, a health response, logs, a synthetic fixture, or a candidate build is not forwarding acceptance.

failure_policy: Before guard claim, any mismatch closes the cohort without an event and without path substitution.
After guard claim, any timeout, child failure, missing/invalid ACK, ledger mismatch or observation failure consumes the one event attempt; no retry, replay or live repair is allowed.
Preserve the guard, final result, redacted helper output and mismatch evidence as owner-only immutable failure evidence; never relabel partial evidence as acceptance.
failure_and_cleanup_contract.cleanup_owner: Hub owns the bounded shared runtime supervisor and exact fresh r6 inputs. Edge owns only its independent evidence review. Neither owner may touch installed Hub 8443, existing HA 18483, historical cohorts, unrelated processes or keychain entries.
ordered_cleanup: Stop only the exact Hub launcher/direct child and record exit result.
Stop only the exact receiver PID after no producer child remains and record exit result.
Stop only the exact Edge PID after final spool/frontier evidence and record exit result.
Remove one-use authorization, bearer, credential and private-key files after their hashes/bindings are sealed in redacted receipts; retain no reusable secret copy.
Verify 18530, 21448, 21449, 21845 and 8082 closed, every recorded PID absent, the guest stopped and the shared heavy-build lock absent.
Retain only the versioned owner-only evidence roots and redacted receipts as closed non-reusable evidence.

non_reuse_and_forbidden: No r1/r2 root, identity, certificate, key, bearer, spool, state database, credential, transaction, port, runtime descriptor, readiness receipt, guard, result or event evidence may be read as an r6 runtime input.
Immutable source artifacts may match prior digests only through a fresh r6 source/staging receipt; no file may be copied from a closed runtime root.

No TLS bypass, arbitrary endpoint, remote/non-loopback receiver listener, extra invitation claim, producer retry, second event, Viewer action, x86 work, deployment, publication, production or vehicle action is allowed.
